jobDescription: Job Title: Manager -Customer Experience The role is pivotal in managing customer complaints and queries, ensuring timely and seamless resolutions. title: Senior Executive Internal Audit
jobDescription: Job Description Senior Executive - Internal Audit & Compliance (Customer Experience) Location Gurgaon, Haryana Department Internal Audit & Compliance (Customer Experience) Role Purpose The Senior Executive - Internal Audit & Compliance will be responsible for auditing customer compensation cases, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines, identifying financial leakages, performing root cause analysis, and supporting governance across customer experience processes. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive process improvements through audit insights. Key Responsibilities Audit & Governance Review and audit customer compensation cases including vouchers, NEFTs, refunds, and voucher payouts. Ensure cases are processed in line with company SOPs, approval matrices, and policy guidelines. Identify control gaps, process deviations, and non-compliance risks. Perform end-to-end case audits and maintain detailed audit trails. Financial Controls Monitor compensation payouts to prevent duplicate payments and financial leakages. Validate supporting documents, approvals, and eligibility criteria before payout approval. Conduct periodic reviews of compensation trends and identify high-risk areas. Track audit savings achieved through intervention and rejection of incorrect payouts. Compliance & Risk Management Ensure adherence to internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements. Review medical and special compensation cases against approved guidelines. Monitor exceptions and escalate risks to management as required. Support internal and external audits by providing data, reports, and documentation. Reporting & Analytics Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly audit reports and dashboards. Analyze compensation trends, audit findings, error rates, and operational metrics. Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams. Maintain trackers for audit observations, savings, and compliance monitoring. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Customer Experience, Operations, Finance, Digital, Quality, and Vendor Partner teams. Provide audit observations and process improvement recommendations. Conduct calibration sessions and governance reviews with stakeholders. Support resolution of escalations and process-related queries. Process Improvement & Automation Identify opportunities for automation and digitization within audit processes. Support implementation of system controls and fraud detection mechanisms. Participate in process enhancement projects to improve efficiency and governance. Assist in development and maintenance of audit SOPs and control frameworks. Required Qualifications Graduate in any discipline. 2-4 years of experience in Internal Audit, Quality, Compliance, Risk Management, Customer Experience Governance, or Process Excellence. Experience in analyzing operational processes and controls. Strong understanding of audit principles and compliance frameworks. Key Skills Internal Audit & Compliance Risk Assessment & Control Review Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Data Analysis & Reporting Financial Control & Governance Process Improvement Microsoft Excel & PowerPoint Stakeholder Management Problem Solving & Decision Making Attention to Detail Success Metrics Audit accuracy and compliance adherence. Reduction in financial leakages and duplicate payouts. Timely completion of audit reviews. Quality and effectiveness of audit observations. Process improvement initiatives implemented. Stakeholder satisfaction and governance effectiveness. Preferred Experience Experience in airline, travel, customer service, shared services, or BPO operations. Exposure to Salesforce, CRM platforms, or workflow tools. Experience in audit dashboards and MIS reporting.

title: Senior Executive - Airline Partnerships
jobDescription: Job Title: Senior Executive – Airline Partnerships Summary: Part of the Airline Partnerships team responsible for supporting the development, implementation, management, and optimization of strategic airline partnerships, including codeshare, interline, and alliance agreements. The role involves coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, managing partnership projects, supporting regulatory approvals, and ensuring successful technical and commercial integration of partner airlines. Key Responsibilities: Partnership Development & Management Support the implementation and negotiation of airline partnership initiatives, including codeshare, interline, and other commercial agreements. Contribute to the overall development, management, and growth of airline partnership relationships. Maintain effective communication with relevant internal departments regarding ongoing commercial agreements and partnership initiatives. Build and maintain strong relationships with partner airlines and key stakeholders. Analysis & Reporting Conduct independent analysis of partnership performance, market developments, and industry trends. Develop reports and dashboards to track alliance and partnership project progress. Assess emerging domestic and international aviation policies and evaluate competitor alliance and partnership activities. Project Management & Implementation Support special projects and strategic assignments related to airline partnerships. Manage technical, functional, and business implementation activities for codeshare, interline, and partnership programs. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution and seamless execution of partnership initiatives. Monitor project timelines, key deliverables, dependencies, and implementation milestones. Regulatory & Commercial Support Support efforts to obtain regulatory approvals, traffic rights, and government clearances required for partnership operations. Assist in managing irregularity and passenger re-protection agreements with partner airlines. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and commercial requirements. Systems & Technology Integration Coordinate IT integration activities for new and existing partners. Manage project execution related to system upgrades, enhancements, and partner onboarding. Collaborate with technology teams to ensure successful deployment and maintenance of partnership-related systems and interfaces. Execution Work closely with Commercial, Network Planning, Revenue Management, Airport Operations, Finance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams to execute partnership initiatives effectively. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful implementation and ongoing management of airline partnership programs. Preferred Skills: Strong understanding of airline operations, airline partnerships, and the aviation industry. Excellent communication, presentation, and business writing skills.
